ideas.title: Salesforce Story Analyzer & Cline Prompt Builder
ideas.description: A ChatGPT Project that converts user story XML files into precise, development-ready outputs for Salesforce. It analyzes acceptance criteria, identifies gaps and risks, and generates a Cline prompt for local-only implementation aligned with PMD rules, naming conventions, and development standards - reducing ambiguity and accelerating delivery.
ideas.currentState: Developers manually read stories, interpret AC, and hand-write prompts; ambiguity causes rework.
ideas.futureState: Story XML in -> gap analysis + risks + ready Cline prompt out, standards-aligned.

ideas.title: AC CTL Team Portal
ideas.description: Team Portal for CTL team, which publishes all the events, teams and opportunities with RFPs and collaboration requests and any forms on initiatives needed.
ideas.currentState: Info scattered across emails/chats; no single place for events, RFPs, collaboration.
ideas.futureState: Central CTL portal for events, opportunities, RFPs, and forms.

ideas.title: Cline -> Lucidchart AI Process Mapping
ideas.description: Use Cline to generate a step-by-step process outline that can be imported into Lucidchart AI, as this approach produces more effective process maps than directly requesting visual flow diagrams from Cline.
ideas.currentState: Manual process mapping; direct AI diagrams are low quality.
ideas.futureState: Cline-generated structured steps feed Lucidchart AI for better maps.

ideas.title: AI Code Review Assistant
ideas.description: Currently Salesforce code reviews are manual, time-consuming, and inconsistent across teams. Developers may miss governor-limit, security, and best-practice issues. This AI code review assistant scans Salesforce code using Salesforce Code Analyzer and uses AI (Cline) to explain findings, suggest fixes, and comment on pull requests. Reviews Apex, LWC, SOQL, triggers, flows, and metadata before pull requests are merged.
ideas.currentState: Manual, inconsistent reviews; issues slip through.
ideas.futureState: Automated AI-assisted review with explanations and fix suggestions on PRs.

ideas.title: AI-Powered HL Solutioning Agent from Client Docs
ideas.description: A Cline workflow that reads all locally stored client engagement files - workshop transcripts, requirements CSVs, pain points, KPIs, data migration docs, and TDDs - and uses a structured prompt to automatically generate a High-Level Solution in a specified output format (e.g. .csv). It cross-references client pain points with Salesforce capabilities, groups findings into epics, and produces HL user stories with effort estimates and dependency flags - ready for sprint planning.
ideas.currentState: Solution architects manually synthesize many documents into HL solutions.
ideas.futureState: Agent produces HL solution, epics, stories, estimates, dependencies from docs.

ideas.title: Generate Test Cases from Grooming Transcript
ideas.description: Since we already create test cases using the story description and acceptance criteria, we can also leverage the sprint grooming transcript alongside the story AC to generate more comprehensive and accurate test cases.
ideas.currentState: Test cases from story/AC only; misses context discussed in grooming.
ideas.futureState: Transcript + AC -> richer, more accurate test cases.

ideas.title: Spec-Driven Payload Generator & Boomi Regression Framework
ideas.description: Develop a reusable Boomi testing framework that reads a standardized mapping document (spec) and Boomi source/target profiles to automatically generate test payloads across multiple scenarios - happy path, boundary values, missing required fields, invalid formats, enum violations, special characters, and lookup hit/miss cases. The framework executes payloads through the relevant Boomi mapping/integration process, validates results (schema/profile validation + rule assertions and/or golden-file comparison), and produces a consolidated pass/fail report with error details and correlation IDs. Creates a repeatable regression suite that accelerates testing and improves mapping quality.
ideas.currentState: Manual, ad-hoc integration test payloads; inconsistent coverage.
ideas.futureState: Spec-driven auto-generated payloads + automated regression + reports.

ideas.title: AI Prompt Library
ideas.description: Create a central library of ready-to-use AI prompts for common tasks like writing user stories, test cases, and helping with code logic or debugging, summaries, and reports. This library will provide simple, structured prompts with clear inputs and expected outputs so that anyone can use AI effectively. It will be easy to access and can be improved over time based on feedback. This will save time, improve consistency, and make AI usage more practical across teams.
ideas.currentState: Everyone writes prompts from scratch; inconsistent results.
ideas.futureState: Central, curated, structured prompt library with inputs/outputs.

ideas.title: Cline Rules & Workflows for Development
ideas.description: For faster metadata generation with zero to minimal syntax errors (Cline sometimes generates metadata irrelevant to Salesforce), which keeps in mind a specific project's code standard, personal preferences of naming conventions for variables/files, error handling, and generates plans faster with less input in prompts for each new task.
ideas.currentState: Cline output needs heavy correction; inconsistent standards.
ideas.futureState: Project-aware Cline rules/workflows produce standards-aligned metadata fast.

ideas.title: Delivery Intelligence Hub
ideas.description: An AI-powered Delivery Intelligence Hub that supports the entire sprint lifecycle: Requirement clarity (Requirement Drift), Reusing organizational knowledge (Knowledge Miner), Simulating sprint execution, Write Story, Generate Test Case modules, and Generating executive-level insights.
ideas.currentState: Fragmented tools across the sprint lifecycle; knowledge not reused.
ideas.futureState: Unified hub spanning requirements -> stories -> tests -> insights.

ideas.title: Collaborative Pre-Sprint Review
ideas.description: Use Cline to scan and upload a user story before the sprint starts, so we can highlight missing scenarios, ambiguity conflicts, suggested acceptance criteria, and test cases, and keep a pre-sprint checkpoint. BA explains story, QA lists test scenarios live, Dev identifies technical risks, and Cline validates gaps instantly.
ideas.currentState: Gaps found mid-sprint; rework and delays.
ideas.futureState: Pre-sprint AI-assisted gap check with BA/QA/Dev in the room.

ideas.title: Fresh Eye - Quarterly Cross-QA Review Event
ideas.description: A quarterly internal event where the QA and BA of a project present a key application flow to a QA from another project for fresh-eye testing. Since long-term project QAs may overlook cosmetic issues, usability gaps, or requirement misses due to familiarity, Fresh Eye brings an unbiased first-impression review. Conducted internally using demo/sandbox environments or screen-sharing walkthroughs (no client data exposure), ensuring confidentiality. The cross-QA tester reviews with a first-impression mindset and raises observations on UI/UX, usability, and potential requirement gaps. Findings are shared with the project team. Drives better product quality, cross-project learning, and stronger QA-BA collaboration - without needing client involvement.
ideas.futureState: Quarterly cross-project fresh-eye reviews with structured findings.

ideas.title: Multi-Party Meeting Slot Finder (Agentforce)
ideas.description: A self-service Experience Cloud portal that finds a common meeting slot across multiple external parties, using Agentforce to broker a compromise when no common slot exists. A support executive proposes candidate slots and emails each party a secure link. Parties select availability (live indicator shows others' picks). If all select the same slot, it is finalized; if not, Agentforce analyzes selections, suggests a best-fit final slot, and auto-nudges non-responders. Fills a gap Salesforce Scheduler cannot (external, non-Salesforce parties). Benefits Legal, Finance/Banking, Insurance, Healthcare, and Public Sector.
ideas.currentState: No true multi-party external consensus scheduling in Salesforce.
ideas.futureState: Agentforce-brokered consensus scheduling portal for external parties.
